trace.detail:
MESSAGE:
Dear Acme Cloud Services team,

Thank you for confirming that our contract is due to end on 31 October 2026, and for your proposal to renew for a further 12 months at a 12% price increase (from Rs 24,00,000 to Rs 26,88,000 annually).

Under Clause 8.2 of our agreement, renewal price increases are capped at 7% unless both parties agree otherwise in writing. A 12% increase exceeds this cap and also exceeds our internal procurement threshold for increases above 10%, which requires such proposals to be negotiated down rather than accepted as presented. We are therefore not in a position to accept the proposed figure.

We would welcome a revised proposal within, or close to, the 7% cap under Clause 8.1/8.2, supported by written justification for the increase given rising infrastructure costs. For reference, current market quotes we have received for comparable services range from approximately 5.5% to 7.8% above our existing monthly fee, which we hope is helpful context for your revised offer.

Separately, per Clause 4.1 and 4.2 of our agreement, monthly uptime fell below the 99.9% SLA in May and July, entitling us to service credits of Rs 20,000 (2 months at Rs 10,000/month), which have not yet been claimed. We request that these credits be applied to our account or offset against renewal fees.

We look forward to your revised proposal so that renewal terms can proceed to final review on our side.

Kind regards,
Nimbus Retail Procurement

INTERNAL NOTE:
Countered 12% inc
